title: There's an Actual Rule for Screen-Tired Eyes
description:
If your eyes feel wrecked after a long day on a screen, eye doctors actually have a specific rule for that.

#shorts #wellbeingfacts #eyehealth

scenes.text: If your eyes feel wrecked after a long day on a screen, there's a real rule for that.
It's called the 20-20-20 rule, and eye doctors actually recommend it.
Every 20 minutes, look at something at least 20 feet away, for at least 20 seconds.
Your eye muscles stay locked into close focus the whole time you're looking at a screen, and that's what causes the strain, not the screen itself.
Looking far away lets those muscles actually relax before you go back to focusing close up again.
It's not a cure for everything, but it's one of the few screen-time habits actually backed by eye doctors.
